rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. No customs, B-L or contract record identified. Status: not confirmed.
note: Sanctions: no match found for VVDN Technologies on the OFAC SDN/Non-SDN consolidated list (checked via sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov, SDN list last updated 23.11.2026); UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List checks could not be completed because the search backend was down — treat as unverified, not as a clean bill. Court cases: one arbitration (Handheld Group AB, Supreme Court, VVDN as respondent), one commercial suit where VVDN is plaintiff against Hero Electronix (Delhi HC, pending), and routine income-tax appeals at ITAT Delhi. Per project rules these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Regulator actions: none found. RF/CIS supply: no trace found. Overall: no sanctions exposure identified, no disqualifying finding; risk profile low-to-unknown pending a re-run of the news/sanctions screening when search is restored.
